issues.description: The template does not export the main symbol (the 'global main' directive is commented out), while the solution explicitly declares 'global main'. The problem statement only tells students to change the register name (ecc -> ecx) and does not mention symbol visibility. Because the main symbol typically must be exported for the linker/runtime to find it, students who follow the written instructions exactly may still get a linking/visibility error after fixing the register, causing confusion. This is a structural visibility mismatch between template and solution and an omission in the template relative to the intended final state.
issues.suggested_fix: Uncomment or add the 'global main' directive in the template (e.g., insert 'global main' before 'extern printf' in template_repository/helloWorld.asm) so the template matches the solution's exported entry symbol. Alternatively, update the problem statement to explicitly instruct students to also export main, but the clearer fix is to include 'global main' in the template to avoid unintended linker errors.
